$comment: Pinned inputs for the golden image. Reproducibility here means pinned inputs plus a
verifiable manifest, not byte-identical images: Packer re-runs Homebrew and npm.
Two builds from this file must produce equal /opt/native-factory/manifest.json apart
from built_at and the image digest.
Versions marked null are resolved at build time and RECORDED in the manifest. Read the
manifest after the first successful build and move them here. Nothing below has been
verified against a real build yet -- see verified_against_build.
Pin the digest, not the tag. HANDOFF 4.4 records sequoia-xcode:latest resolving to
16.4 while 26.x tags exist. Fill `digest` from the first pull and switch `ref` to
the ...@sha256:... form; ProjectConfig.vm.pinned_by_digest reports which form is in use.
The base image already provides: Xcode + platforms, Homebrew, git, node@24, mise,
openjdk@17, Android cmdline-tools, platform-tools, platforms;android-36,
build-tools;36.0.0, NDK, tuist, fastlane, tart-guest-agent, SIP disabled.

python.$comment: Installed and managed by uv, not by the system.

$comment: ACP adapters are installed globally at a pinned version rather than invoked with
`npx -y` as HANDOFF 4.1 writes them. npx resolves and downloads at invocation, which
would make a reproducible image depend on npm reachability and on whatever version is
latest at run time. See ADR-0003.
Requires Java 17+, already in the base image. The iOS XCTest driver has recurring
hang issues on new macOS/Xcode combinations (HANDOFF 4.9), so this is pinned
alongside Xcode and the pair is smoke-tested in Milestone 5.

openhands.$comment: Installed at Milestone 1, configured at Milestone 2.

$comment: The emulator cannot run in a macOS guest: an ARM64 AVD needs Hypervisor.framework
and fails with HV_UNSUPPORTED when nested. It runs on the host instead (ADR-0002).
The guest doctor asserts its absence; a present emulator is a build error.
